STEP 1 - Scene: A small salad-style starter on a white square plate, photographed from above at a slight angle. It contains leafy greens, roasted beet pieces, a slice of striped (Chioggia) beet, roasted potato or squash cubes, and a dollop of white cream or soft cheese.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The plate is a square dish roughly 26 cm across at its widest edge. Area ≈ 26 x 26 x ~0.8 (rounded corners) ≈ 540 cm²; I use ~530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: mixed green leaves (lettuce, spinach-like leaves), red-leaf lettuce piece, roasted beet cubes (dark red), roasted golden potato/squash cubes, one sliced Chioggia beet round, a white cream/cheese dollop, and small crumbs or nuts.

STEP 4 - Area (% of plate):
- Mixed leaves: 30% ≈ 159 cm²
- Roasted beet cubes: 5% ≈ 27 cm²
- Roasted potato/squash cubes: 5% ≈ 27 cm²
- Chioggia beet slice: 3% ≈ 16 cm²
- Cream/cheese dollop: 4% ≈ 21 cm²
- Nuts/crumbs and dressing: 2% ≈ 11 cm²
Total food coverage ≈ 49% of plate, consistent with a small starter.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Leaves: 159 cm² x 3 cm ≈ 477 ml
- Beet cubes: 27 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 40 ml
- Potato/squash cubes: 27 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 40 ml
- Chioggia slice: 16 cm² x 0.8 cm ≈ 13 ml
- Cream/cheese: 21 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 32 ml
- Nuts/crumbs: 11 cm² x 0.5 cm ≈ 6 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Leaves: 477 x 0.15 ≈ 72 g
- Beet cubes: 40 x 0.6 ≈ 24 g
- Potato/squash: 40 x 0.6 ≈ 24 g
- Chioggia beet: 13 x 0.6 ≈ 8 g
- Cream/cheese: 32 x 0.95 ≈ 30 g
- Nuts/crumbs: 6 x 0.5 ≈ 3 g
Total ≈ 161 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Leaves: 72 g x 20 kcal/100g ≈ 14 kcal
- Beet cubes: 24 g x 43 ≈ 10 kcal
- Potato/squash: 24 g x 90 ≈ 22 kcal
- Chioggia beet: 8 g x 43 ≈ 3 kcal
- Cream/cheese: 30 g x 300 ≈ 90 kcal
- Nuts/crumbs: 3 g x 550 ≈ 17 kcal
Total ≈ 156 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 160 g of mostly greens with a modest cheese portion and roasted vegetables, around 150 kcal, is plausible for a small starter salad on a 26 cm plate.
